description: Official EXOCHRONOS system state snapshot (governance artifact). Records component readiness, gap assessment, packet status (C01-C08), owner decision point, and next-phase pipeline. All claims are LOCAL_ONLY — no external proof.
function: Official EXOCHRONOS system state snapshot — component readiness, gap assessment, packet status, owner decision point

outputs.name: component_status
outputs.description: Readiness status of each system component

outputs.name: repo_metrics
outputs.description: Coverage percentages, test counts, equivalence pass counts

outputs.name: packet
outputs.description: Packet C01-C08 status, hash, canonical flag

outputs.name: owner_decision_point
outputs.description: Option A vs B decision criteria

outputs.name: next_phase
outputs.description: Next gate, artifact, metric, and pipeline steps

outputs.name: blocked_claims
outputs.description: Claims permanently blocked at current maturity

outputs.name: allowed_claims
outputs.description: Claims allowed within scope with support status

public_api.name: EXOCHRONOS_STATE_v1.json
public_api.description: Load and read the state snapshot. Top-level keys: _schema, _version, _date, _claim_ceiling, convergence, component_status, gap_assessment, repo_metrics, packet, owner_decision_point, next_phase, axioms, blocked_claims, allowed_claims
